definitions.explanation: An informal, affectionate term for one's own mother. Typically used by men.

examples.japanese: おふくろ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
おふくろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、おふくろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a kid, I was often scolded by my mom.

notes:
An affectionate, informal word for one's own mother. Carries a warm, nostalgic nuance.

GENDER AND REGISTER:
Primarily used by men. Women more commonly say ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧ or ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧. Sounds masculine and casual — not used in formal contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- おふくろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: mother's home cooking (nostalgic nuance)
- おふくろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似|に}る→似る：01159_niru⟧: to take after one's mother

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧: neutral/humble term for one's own mother
- ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧: polite, general term for mother
- ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧: casual, used by children and women
- ⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧: formal, objective term (as in documents)

WRITING:
Can be written as お{袋|ふくろ}, but hiragana is more common.
